name: Ferienwohnung Schwaiger
beschreibung:
Quietly set in Erl, the Schwaiger family welcomes guests with genuine Tyrolean warmth in a well-maintained apartment featuring a mountain-view balcony.

The Erl festival venues, trails to the Blaubergalm, and riverside cycling along the Inn are all close by.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Schwaiger in Erl provides comfortable holiday accommodation in the festival village of Kufsteinerland.
